name: THANKS, LIGHT.
languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Ukrainian, Russian, Indonesian, Turkish, Greek, Polish, Thai, Swedish, Finnish, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil
short: A first-person puzzler where light reshapes physics and geometry — a glitch-laced mystery for the people who still keep a portal gun, a camera, and a perspective shift in their library.
about: Wishlist!             About the Game   Flat in shadow. Tall in light.    Shine to raise. Absorb to flatten.   A first-person puzzler for the people who still keep a portal gun, a camera, and a perspective shift bookmarked in their library.                          Shine light to give shadow weight.   A flat square unfolds into a staircase. A fragile outline turns into a towering pillar. Light grants mass, collision, gravity — and once it's solid, you climb it, push it, drop it.             Absorb light to switch Physics off.   A rolling ball lies still. A wall becomes a doorway. Mass vanishes — and what blocked you now lets you through.             The mechanic keeps growing.   Mirrors duplicate. Lenses resize. Merging fuses two forms into a new one.    Three chapters deep. Five mechanics that learn to talk to each other.  The deeper you go, the more the rules combine.  Built to escalate — never just adding, always recombining.    3 chapters · 6+ hours · 60+ Stages.             A world that watches you solve it.   An unnamed Administrator built this place to be flawless. A marble museum gives way to an office that repeats one hallway too many times, and finally to a black-and-white space where memory leaks through the walls. The architecture is your second puzzle — read it carefully.    Watch out for the beings hiding in the shadows...
